status: synthetic/Python smoke only; NOT Spark or publishable public-data evidence

definition.rss: peak over polling snapshots of sum of resident bytes for root Python process and recursively discoverable descendants (including local JVM/Python Spark workers); includes baseline resident memory; shared pages may be counted more than once; not PSS or total machine memory
definition.cpu: sum of maximum observed cumulative user+system CPU seconds per (pid,creation_time) minus the initial snapshot for existing processes; newly observed processes created during measurement start from zero. Short-lived or inaccessible processes may be missed. Sampling thread CPU is included in root.
definition.limits: sampling may miss transient peaks and exited processes; remote workers/non-descendant services excluded; no swap/page-cache/other-machine accounting; AccessDenied and disappeared processes recorded
